correctness.rationale: PASS. Audited exact additive EFX definition as removing each item from the envious agent own bundle. For 19<r<21, a bundle with two A chores either violates the average cost of other bundles after a deletion or requires two disjoint small-only bundles each of cost 20, impossible since x+7y=20 with 0≤x,y≤5 has no integer solution. Therefore exactly one agent has no A. If any A-holder valued this bundle below r, that A-holder must have only A, forcing the no-A bundle to contain at least three B and C and violate EFX against the A-singleton. Hence its B,C counts x,y≥3, giving threshold ≥23; pigeonhole one other A-holder contains no C and at most two B, evaluated below r+2<23: contradiction. Seven explicitly listed complete allocation vectors have independently recomputed exact affine feasible intervals (7,13], [11,19], [21,23], [23,25], [25,38], [32,39], [39,∞); union covers every allowed exterior real parameter and includes both r=19,21 boundaries. Independently enumerated every 62,720 type-count allocation at each rational r=39/2,20,41/2; these finite points supplement, do not replace, the whole-open-interval proof.
